littletiles.history.undo_failed: Cannot undo: no history, out of reach, or the block has changed.
littletiles.history.redo_failed: Cannot redo: no history, out of reach, or the block has changed.
tooltip.littletiles.hammer: Right-click a full block to convert it; click a tile to extract it.
tooltip.littletiles.saw: Split ordinary blocks or micro-tiles. G: cut depth and mode.
tooltip.littletiles.wrench: Right-click to rotate; sneak-right-click to mirror the tile group.
tooltip.littletiles.chisel: Cut ordinary full blocks directly. G: grid, size and cut mode.
tooltip.littletiles.color: Hold dye in the off hand and right-click a tile to tint it.
tooltip.littletiles.collision: Right-click a tile to toggle its physical collision.
tooltip.littletiles.mallet: Right-click to merge adjacent matching cuboids without filling gaps.
tooltip.littletiles.blueprint: Two corners: copy. Sneak-use: paste. G: placement mode. R/F: transform.
littletiles.selection.first: First corner marked. Select the other corner.
